prototypes.finding: Darkened the window without enough distinct surface identity. Do not treat changed pixels/valid gloss as an experience gain.
Glass old painted band became continuous and sky gradient readable. Broad sinusoidal normal field created large blotches on stone; rejected that generator.

finalApproach: Keep coherent pane UV mapping; replace broad periodic sine normals with small deterministic crystal grains and recessed panel joints. No more fine parameter loops; perform actual phase comparison and decide against original V3condition.
